content: Multi-host flakes: standard pattern is plain flake.nix defining nixosConfigurations via lib.nixosSystem per host, DRYed with a mkHost helper function driven by specialArgs { inherit inputs; }; home-manager join via home-manager.nixosModules.home-manager with home-manager.useGlobalPkgs=true; useUserPackages=true; extraSpecialArgs; users.<name>=./home.nix. Discourse-confirmed pattern. Community consensus model.
